privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how DTS Delivery (“DTS”, “we”) collects, uses, and protects personal data when you use our mobile apps (customer and driver), the merchant web panel, and dtsdrop.com.

sections.title: 1. Controller
paragraphs: Data controller: DTS Delivery / Oscar Herrera. Privacy and support contact: soporte@dtsdrop.com.

sections.title: 2. Data we process
paragraphs: Account: name, email, phone, profile photo (if provided), and Google or Apple sign-in identifiers.
Orders and deliveries: delivery address, order contents, status history, and order chat messages.
Location: device coordinates when you search nearby stores, set a driver work zone, or use live delivery tracking (with your permission).
Device and notifications: FCM tokens, platform (iOS/Android), and technical data needed for security and performance.
Merchants: business details, catalog, logos, and product photos published in the merchant panel.

sections.title: 3. Purposes
paragraphs: Provide the marketplace and delivery service (accounts, orders, operational payments, chat, and tracking).
Send push notifications about order status, driver offers, and relevant messages.
Improve security (authentication, fraud prevention) and platform reliability.
Meet legal obligations and handle support or account-deletion requests.

sections.title: 4. Legal bases
paragraphs: Performance of a contract when you create an account and use the apps or panel.
Consent for location and push notifications when the OS prompts you.
Legitimate interests in security, abuse prevention, and service improvement, balanced against your rights.

sections.title: 5. Processors and third parties
paragraphs: Firebase / Google (Authentication, Cloud Messaging) and Apple (Sign in with Apple) for identity and notifications.
Hosting infrastructure (e.g. Railway) for API, database, and media storage.
We do not sell your personal data to third parties for advertising.

sections.title: 6. Retention
paragraphs: We keep data while your account is active and as needed to provide the service.
After a deletion request, we delete or anonymize account data within 30 days, except where law requires limited retention (e.g. accounting or claims).

sections.title: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access, correction, objection, restriction, or deletion by emailing soporte@dtsdrop.com or using the Delete account page on dtsdrop.com.
You can also revoke location and notification permissions in your device settings.

sections.title: 8. Children
paragraphs: The service is not directed to children under 13 (or the applicable minimum age in your jurisdiction). If we learn of an unauthorized minor account, we will delete it.

sections.title: 9. Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy. The update date appears at the bottom of the page. Continued use after a material change means you have been informed; we will notify you of material changes when reasonable.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern use of DTS Delivery: mobile apps (customer and driver), the merchant web panel, and dtsdrop.com. By registering or using the service you accept these terms.

sections.title: 1. The service
paragraphs: DTS connects merchants, customers, and drivers for product and service orders with optional delivery.
Unless stated otherwise, DTS is not the seller of merchant products; the sale contract is between customer and merchant.

sections.title: 2. Accounts
paragraphs: You must provide accurate information and keep access confidential (password or linked Google/Apple accounts).
Roles differ (customer, driver, merchant). Do not use one role’s app with another role’s account.

sections.title: 3. Customers
paragraphs: Prices, availability, and ETAs are set by the merchant. Provide a valid delivery address and be available to receive the order.
Order chat is only for coordinating delivery; harassment or illegal content is prohibited.

sections.title: 4. Drivers
paragraphs: Comply with traffic laws and hold any permits required in your area.
Going online shares location for matching and tracking. Complete accepted deliveries in good faith.

sections.title: 5. Merchants
paragraphs: You are responsible for catalog accuracy, stock, prices, allergens, and images.
Comply with applicable law (health, tax, consumer) and fulfill accepted orders.

sections.title: 6. Content and IP
paragraphs: You retain rights to content you upload. You grant DTS a limited license to host and display it on the platform.
The DTS Delivery brand and platform software are owned by DTS or its licensors.

sections.title: 7. Prohibited use
paragraphs: Do not manipulate the system, create fake accounts, interfere with others, or use the service for illegal activity.

sections.title: 8. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: The service is provided “as is”. To the fullest extent permitted by law, DTS is not liable for indirect damages, lost profits, or outages beyond our reasonable control.
Disputes about product quality or merchant delays should first be raised with the merchant; DTS may mediate reasonably.

sections.title: 9. Termination
paragraphs: You may stop using the service and request account deletion at any time.
We may suspend or close accounts that violate these terms or endanger the platform.

sections.title: 10. Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these terms: soporte@dtsdrop.com.

deleteAccount.title: Delete my account
deleteAccount.intro: In line with Apple App Store policies and privacy best practices, you may request permanent deletion of your DTS Delivery account.

sections.title: What is deleted
paragraphs: User profile, linked sign-in data (Google/Apple in our database), saved addresses, notification tokens, and app preferences.
Order history may be anonymized or retained in limited form if required by law (e.g. accounting obligations).

sections.title: Timeline
paragraphs: We process requests within 30 days of confirmation. We may contact the email you provide to verify account ownership.

sections.title: How to request
paragraphs: Complete the form below with the same email as your DTS account, or email soporte@dtsdrop.com with subject “Delete account” and the app (customer, driver, or merchant).

form.confirmLabel: I confirm I want to permanently delete my account and understand this cannot be undone.
form.success: We received your request. We will process it within 30 days.
form.error: Could not submit the request. Try again or email support.

appReview.title: App Review guide
appReview.intro: Instructions for App Store / Play Console reviewers. Demo account credentials are provided in App Store Connect (Review Information), not on this page.

sections.title: Sign-in
paragraphs: Customer and driver apps support email/password (where enabled) and social login: Google Sign-In and Sign in with Apple (iOS).
Use the demo account provided in App Store Connect (Demo Required = Yes). If social login shows an account picker, choose the test account listed in the review notes.

sections.title: What to test — customer app
paragraphs: Browse nearby stores and featured products; open a store and view the catalog.
Create or review an order, tracking / status, and order chat if an active order exists.
Location / search-radius settings if available in profile.

sections.title: What to test — driver app
paragraphs: Complete profile onboarding if prompted; go online / offline.
View order offers in the work zone, accept an offer, and follow the delivery flow (map / statuses).
Open chat for the assigned order.
